title: The semiclassical limit from Hartree to Vlasov at positive density: strong uniform-in-time convergence and scattering
summary: Strong semiclassical convergence from the Hartree equation to the Vlasov equation is established in three dimensions near Penrose-stable homogeneous steady states at positive density. For sufficiently regular integrable interaction kernels, an $O(\hbar^2)$ convergence rate in weighted Sobolev spaces is proved on finite time intervals. Combining this estimate with earlier uniform-in-$\hbar$ phase-mixing and scattering bounds for the Hartree equation yields global existence and scattering for the corresponding Vlasov solution through the semiclassical limit.
